decisive_spans.text: An induced sputum was trace positive for MTB on GeneXpert and subsequently grew MTB sensitive to rifampicin and isoniazid
Chest radiograph showed bilateral reticular-nodular opacities

response.rationale: D9 is strongly supported by the positive GeneXpert and culture for MTB from sputum, along with chest imaging findings. D6 is also strongly supported by imaging findings, but the sputum results directly point to pulmonary involvement.
